senses.gloss:
दद् 1. दद्, a reduplicated form substituted
for rt. 1. दा, to give, before certain affixes and
[]
terminations (Pāṇ. VI. 4, 126; VII. 4, 46; VIII. 2,
38), and by some grammarians given as a separate
rt.: cl. 1. A. ददते, &c., to give, (see rt. 1. दा.)
2. दद्, giving, in आयुर्-दद्.
दद, अस्, आ, अम्, giving; [cf. अभयन्-दद.]

दाद, अस्, m. (fr. base दद्), a gift, donation,
oblation, giving.
—दाद-द, अस्, m. a donor, giver
of a gift.
दाद दाद, दादिन्, &c. See p. 407, col. 2.

ददत्, अत्, अती, अत् (pres. part. of rt. 1. दा),
giving, presenting.
ददन, अम्, n. gift, giving, donation.

ददि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. giving, bestowing, distributing
(with acc.); [cf. Pāṇ. II. 3, 69.]

ददिवस्, वान्, दुषी, वस्, who or what has
given.
ददिवस्; for ‘वस्’ read वत्.

ददद ददद, an onomatopoetic word for
the roaring of thunder.

ददरि ददरि, N. of a river.
—ददरि-
सङ्गम, N. of a place mentioned in the Rasika-
ramaṇa by Raghu-nātha.

ददाश्वस् ददाश्वस्, वान्, उषी, वस् (perf. part.
fr. rt. 1. दाश्), worshipping, serving the gods, giving,
having given or bestowed.
ददाश्वस्; for ‘वस्’ read वत्.

ददृक्षेण्य ददृक्षेण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1.
दृश्), Ved. worth seeing, worthy to be seen, (Pāṇ.
III. 4, 14; according to some दिदृक्षेण्य, q. v.,
is the only correct form.)

ददृशान-पवि, इस्, m., Ved. having the track
of the wheels visible; epithet of Agni; (Sāy.) having
a thunderbolt or weapon visible.

ददृशिवस् or ददृश्वस्, वान्, उषी, वस्, having
seen, having looked at.
ददृशिवस्; for ‘वस्’ read वत्.

ददृत् ददृत्, त्, त्, त् (reduplicated form fr.
rt. दॄ), tearing, splitting, bursting out.

दद्रु, उस्, or ऊ, ऊस्, m. f. [cf. दर्द्रु], a cuta-
neous eruption or rash, herpes; a kind of leprosy,
(or according to others) a ringworm; a tortoise.
—दद्रु-घ्न or दद्रू-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, de-
stroying or removing cutaneous eruptions; (अस्), m.
ringworm-shrub, Cassia Tora or Alata; Psoralea
Corylifolia, (commonly Hākuc; the seeds are used
as a remedy for cutaneous diseases.)

दद्रुक, अस्, m. cutaneous eruption or scab,
leprosy.

दद्रुण or दद्रूण, अस्, आ, अम्, or दद्रु-
रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, herpetic, afflicted with cutaneous
diseases or ringworm; [cf. दर्द्रु-रोगिन्.]
दादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, giving, a giver.

दादाभाई दादाभाई, N. of the author of
the Kiraṇāvalī (a commentary on the Indian astro-
nomical work Sūrya-siddhānta).
